#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

const int64_t MOD = 998244353;

int64_t power(int64_t x, int64_t y, int64_t p) {
    int64_t res = 1;
    x %= p;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1)
            res = (res * x) % p;
        y >>= 1;
        x = (x * x) % p;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int64_t n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;

    int64_t k = n * m;
    int64_t len = r - l + 1;

    if (k % 2 == 1) {
        cout << power(len, n * m, MOD) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    int64_t ans = (power(len, k, MOD) + power(len % 2, k, MOD)) % MOD;
    ans = (ans * power(2, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD;
    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
